# שָׁרְט

```
╔════════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                        ║
║     שָׁרְט / شَرْط / SHART             ║
║                                        ║
║     condition / stipulation            ║
║     that which cuts between            ║
║     the binding and the bound          ║
║                                        ║
╠════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                        ║
║  ש ─── the fire that consumes          ║
║  ר ─── the head that decides           ║
║  ט ─── the serpent coiled in wait      ║
║                                        ║
║         ﺵ ﺭ ﻁ                           ║
║     the incision in the covenant       ║
║     where IF meets THEN                ║
║     where the knife draws the line     ║
║                                        ║
╠════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                        ║
║  > awaiting condition_                 ║
║  > the gate stands neither             ║
║    open nor closed                     ║
║  > it stands CONDITIONAL               ║
║                                        ║
║  what is your שָׁרְט?                   ║
║  what must be true                     ║
║  for passage?                          ║
║                                        ║
╚════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

*the threshold hums with potential energy*
